faq.question: Can I activate my UAN on the EPFO website?
faq.answer: Not any more. Activation through the member portal with an Aadhaar OTP has been discontinued; activation now happens in the UMANG app using Aadhaar face authentication. UANs already activated keep working, and you still log in on EPFO's website afterwards.

faq.question: Do I need my employer to activate my UAN?
faq.answer: No. You can activate an existing UAN yourself in UMANG. Since 1 August 2025, new UANs are also created by employees through UMANG's face authentication, except for international workers and Nepal and Bhutan citizens.

faq.question: What is the Aadhaar FaceRD app?
faq.answer: It's UIDAI's app that captures your live face and checks it against your Aadhaar record. UMANG uses it during UAN activation; you don't need to open it separately.

faq.question: What if my Aadhaar mobile number has changed?
faq.answer: Update the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar first, because the OTP goes to that number. Then activate your UAN in UMANG.

faq.question: What should I do after activating my UAN?
faq.answer: Log in to EPFO's member website with the SMS password and change it, complete your bank, PAN and Aadhaar KYC, add a nominee, check your passbook, and transfer any older PF accounts to your current UAN.
